justification: This changes which zones trigger the Apartment Design Guide panel on the SEPP tab — a regulatory-permissibility gate that was showing on lots where apartments are not permitted. Wrong here means either a false regulatory panel (over-showing) or hiding ADG where it genuinely applies (under-showing), both user-facing on a compliance surface, so it needs unit coverage across metro/regional and fail-closed handling of missing inputs.

pre_impl.existing_data: The SEPP tab already computes LMR applicability correctly via isLMRApplicable and shows Housing SEPP LMR as not applicable for regional R3, but the ADG section used a separate flat APARTMENT_PERMITTING zone list (including R1/R2/R3) that ignored the LGA, so it contradicted the LMR determination on the same page.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Verified live on 38 Park Road Bowral: zone R3, LGA Wingecarribee, the page shows Low and Mid-Rise Reforms not applicable yet still renders the Apartment Design Guide panel, confirming the ADG gate and the LMR gate disagree for the same property.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the existing isLMREligibleZone and isLMRStage2Region helpers rather than adding a new hardcoded permitted-use table; the new permitsApartmentDevelopment helper narrows R1 to R3 to Stage-2 regions while leaving R4 and business or mixed-use zones unchanged.

functions.name: permitsApartmentDevelopment
functions.input: a zone string such as R3: Medium Density Residential and an LGA name from the planning portal constraints
functions.output: true only when an apartment or residential flat building is permissible, so the ADG panel and requirement fetch are gated on real permissibility
functions.if_none: an unknown or empty LGA on an R1 to R3 zone fails closed and returns false rather than showing the ADG on an unverifiable lot

values.read_at: StateLevelControls loadADGRequirements and the showADGSection gate both read the zone and LGA from portal constraints
values.if_missing: empty zone or LGA resolves to a non-permitting result so neither the ADG fetch nor the ADG panel renders for that property

break_it.scenario: A property arrives with a valid R3 zone but a missing or blank LGA name from the portal constraints response
break_it.what_happens: isLMRStage2Region matches every region for an empty string because every string contains the empty substring, so the ADG panel would show on an unverifiable lot
break_it.how: permitsApartmentDevelopment fails closed and returns false when the LGA is empty for an R1 to R3 zone before consulting the region check
break_it.repro: call permitsApartmentDevelopment with zone R3 and an empty LGA and confirm it returns false rather than true

break_it.scenario: A genuine metropolitan medium-density R3 lot inside a designated Stage-2 region opens the SEPP tab expecting apartment guidance
break_it.what_happens: over-tightening the gate to exclude all R3 would wrongly hide the Apartment Design Guide where mid-rise apartments are actually permitted
break_it.how: R1 to R3 still qualify when isLMREligibleZone and isLMRStage2Region both hold, so metro Inner West style R3 keeps showing the panel
break_it.repro: call permitsApartmentDevelopment with zone R3 and LGA Inner West and confirm it returns true

break_it.scenario: A high-density R4 lot sits in a regional LGA that is outside every Stage-2 designated region
break_it.what_happens: gating apartments purely on LMR would wrongly hide ADG on R4 land where the Standard Instrument already permits residential flat buildings
break_it.how: R4 and business or mixed-use zones are not in the LMR-dependent list, so they return true regardless of region
break_it.repro: call permitsApartmentDevelopment with zone R4 and LGA Wingecarribee and confirm it returns true

post_merge.manual_verify: Reproduced on the preview that 38 Park Road Bowral R3 no longer renders the Apartment Design Guide panel and instead shows the not-applicable card, while a metro R3 and any R4 still show it; eight unit tests cover regional R3, metro R3, regional R2, Stage-2 R2, R4 anywhere, mixed-use zones, non-apartment zones, and empty input.
